errors.UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: Unsupported file type. Allowed: PDF, DOCX, DOC, TXT, ZIP.
errors.CV_EXTRACT_FAILED: Couldn't extract text from the file (it might be a scan or image).
errors.LINKEDIN_ARCHIVE_INVALID: Couldn't read the archive. It must be a .zip export from LinkedIn (Settings → Get a copy of your data).
errors.LINKEDIN_ARCHIVE_MISSING_FILES: No Profile.csv / Positions.csv / Skills.csv found in the archive.
errors.CV_SHARE_NOT_FOUND: This CV link doesn't exist or has been disabled
errors.VACANCY_FETCH_FAILED: Could not extract text from the page (it may be empty or protected against scraping).
errors.VACANCY_IMPORT_TOO_MANY: Too many items in one import (max 1000)
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.AI_RATE_LIMITED: Too many AI requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
